kpis.description_fr: Retail = brands consommateurs (Hormel, Skippy, Jennie-O, Spam, Hormel Black Label). Pression FMCG + private label.
kpis.description_en: Retail = consumer brands (Hormel, Skippy, Jennie-O, Spam, Hormel Black Label). FMCG + private label pressure.

kpis.description_fr: Foodservice = restaurants + institutional. Plus gros relais croissance vs Retail. Marges supérieures.
kpis.description_en: Foodservice = restaurants + institutional. Larger growth driver than Retail. Higher margins.

kpis.description_fr: International = Chine, Brésil, autres marchés émergents. Modeste mais croissance pour diversifier hors USA.
kpis.description_en: International = China, Brazil, other emerging markets. Modest but growing to diversify outside USA.

kpis.description_fr: Acquisition Planters de Kraft Heinz 2021 pour 3.4 Mds $. Catégorie snacks. Intégration encore en cours après pression marges.
kpis.description_en: Planters acquired from Kraft Heinz 2021 for $3.4B. Snacks category. Integration ongoing post margin pressure.

kpis.description_fr: 58 années consécutives hausse dividende. Membre Dividend Aristocrats S&P 500. Record sectoriel. Discipline distributions.
kpis.description_en: 58 consecutive years of dividend increases. S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrat member. Sector record. Distribution discipline.

notes: Hormel fiscal year se termine fin octobre (FY24 = nov 2023-oct 2024).
